title: A timeout for each call
hints: Doing the calls one after another means the timeouts add up. Run each call (and its own timeout) in a separate goroutine.
Each goroutine does what timeouts_01 did for one call, then writes its Result into results[i]. Wait for all of them with a sync.WaitGroup.

for i, call := range calls { wg.Add(1); go func() { defer wg.Done(); ch := make(chan int, 1); go func() { ch <- call() }(); select { case v := <-ch: results[i] = Result{Value: v}; case <-time.After(d): results[i] = Result{TimedOut: true} } }() }; wg.Wait()
